title: Garmin Run Philippines 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Garmin Run Philippines 2026 Review | Filinvest City
meta_description: Garmin Run Philippines review: a record 7,700 runners at Filinvest City, Alabang, in October 2025, including 238 from abroad, and the full podium results.
dek: Garmin's Manila stop drew a record 7,700 runners to Filinvest City in Alabang for its second edition in October 2025. Here is what that edition was like, ahead of 2026.
verdict: Garmin Run Philippines is a big brand race in the south of Metro Manila. The 2025 edition, its second, drew a record 7,700 runners to the Filinvest City Events Grounds in Alabang, including 238 runners from more than 20 countries [1]. It offered the 21 km, 10 km and 5 km [1]. Corsino Satinitigan won the men's 21 km in 1:10:38 and Jessa Mae Roda the women's in 1:31:45 [1]. If you want a large, well-attended half marathon with an international mix, it is a good option.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: More than 7,000 runners, a record 7,700 across all categories, took part in the second Garmin Run Asia Series race in Manila, at the Filinvest City Events Grounds in Alabang, Muntinlupa [1].

238 of them came from more than 20 countries, from Japan, Malaysia and Singapore to Italy, Germany, the Netherlands and the United States, alongside Garmin Run Club members and other running groups [1].

sections.heading: The Front of the Race
paragraphs: Corsino Satinitigan won the men's 21 km in 1:10:38, ahead of David Kipkoech Kipsang and Ritchie Estampador, and Jessa Mae Roda won the women's in 1:31:45 [1]. Welmer Jeck Labrador and Edna Magtubo won the 10 km [1].
Finishers who met the qualifying time received a completion medal and an electronic certificate [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: If you want a half marathon near Manila with a big, mixed field, yes. The 2025 turnout was a record for the race.
The published account is about turnout and results, not the course itself, so look at the route map for 2026 before you plan your pacing.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2025 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: Where is Garmin Run Philippines held?
faqs.answer: At the Filinvest City Events Grounds in Alabang, Muntinlupa, in the south of Metro Manila. It is the Philippine stop of the Garmin Run Asia Series.
